## ⚠️ Want to Add a New Prompt?

**Please don't edit `prompts.csv` directly!**

Instead, submit prompts through your own deployment (or a PR to `prompts.csv` if you maintain a fork without the web sync):

1. **Login with GitHub** - Click the login button and authenticate with your GitHub account
2. **Create your prompt** - Use the prompt editor to add your new prompt
3. **Submit** - Your prompt will be reviewed and a [GitHub Action](https://github.com/skinheadH/HBB-prompts.chat/actions/workflows/update-contributors.yml) can update the contributors list

This ensures proper attribution, formatting, and keeps the repository in sync. You'll also appear on the [Contributors page](https://github.com/skinheadH/HBB-prompts.chat/graphs/contributors)!
